editorial.blurb: Legend Tasty House serves up theatrical rolled ice cream that's genuinely delicious, with fresh fruit and creative flavors that keep families coming back for more.
editorial.insiderTip: Go late night when the vibe is buzzing—the strawberry Oreo and Legend green tea are customer favorites, and portions are generous enough to share between two people.
